theme: ceilings CE-4 AI budget covers callees
text: INTERPRETER (tree and VM): an @[ai(policy(budget: N))] budget now bounds every model call made while the fn's activation is on the stack, callees included, and counts ai_extract::<T> calls as well as ai_complete. Each call is checked against every live budget frame, innermost first; the first exhausted one stops the run with E1301 (exit 5) naming that fn. A program whose budgeted fn reached AI through an un-budgeted helper, through a callee with a larger budget, or through extracts, and exited 0 past its budget, now exits 5. Programs without budget: are unchanged; native builds already refused every budgeted fn (E0910).
